sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r16/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 14 = check 13; Internal Quality Checks row 14; Deterministic Checks rows 4 check-assets-referenced.py and 12 check-fixtures.py)
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r16/task/environment/instructions/{overview,integration,policy}.md (full) and a path/cross-reference grep over all six notes
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r16/task/solution/solve.sh and solution/app/server.js (grep for seed/asset reads and INSERTs)
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r16/task/tests/test.sh (asset handling), tests/app_context.md, tests/*/*/prompt.md (grep for seed/asset/fixture assumptions), task.toml
evidence: Paths named by the brief exist and are staged. instruction.md:3 says 'Please read the six notes in /instructions ... /assets/seed_data.json describes the starting scope; there is no starter app to finish.' environment/instructions/ holds exactly six notes (behaviour, integration, overview, policy, security, ui) and environment/assets/ holds seed_data.json (149 bytes). environment/Dockerfile has 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/' and 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets', and is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile. Cross-references between notes resolve: integration.md names security.md, policy.md names ui.md; no note names a missing file or any other /assets path. Content matches every consumer: the seed parses as JSON and is {"snippets": [], "note": "No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. Build a JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history."}, which agrees with integration.md '/assets/seed_data.json describes the starting scope and contains no user snippets or starter implementation'. The golden does not read the seed (no /assets or seed reference in solution/app/server.js; its only startup INSERT is an 'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO snippet_revisions' backfill from existing snippets rows, and solve.sh removes app.db before copying), so it starts with an empty library as the seed states. No judge prompt assumes seeded records: tests/app_context.md:24 says 'the library may already hold records from earlier checks. Do not assume an empty library', and functional/prompt.md:25 says 'You may choose the exact fixture text for each criterion', so no fixture file is needed from /assets. tests/test.sh only touches /assets with 'chmod -R a+rX /assets 2>/dev/null || true' (line 88) and task.toml lists it under artifacts; neither depends on its content. Runtime: all 16 scripted-golden artifact hashes in raw-evidence-index.json recomputed and match; that run installed with solve.sh inside the agent image, which is consistent with the image building with these COPY lines. I did not build the image myself and the private check-assets-referenced.py / check-fixtures.py were not executed; their documented behaviour was applied by hand. Notes (not defects): (1) the seed is a near-empty placeholder whose only content is prose, so it carries no data an app must load; a builder that ignores it and one that reads it produce the same product, which is what the brief says. (2) The golden serves its bundle at the URL path /assets/index.js; this is an HTTP route under /app/public and has no relation to the filesystem /assets directory. Weak-app probe: an app that preloads sample snippets is not contradicted by the seed alone but no criterion relies on an empty library, so no mis-grade follows; conforming-alternative probe: an app that never opens /assets/seed_data.json loses nothing.
run_verdict: PARTIAL: scripted golden on these bytes installed and ran in the agent image (hashes verified); no configured judge run on these bytes and private deterministic checkers not executed.
